_note: The real Webcamo desktop app (Electron) with the real iPhone over USB. Settings are isolated (XDG_CONFIG_HOME) and the phone's own settings are restored after each clip.

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.getElementById('c-res'); s.value = '1280x720'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); })()
(() => { const s = document.getElementById('c-fps'); s.value = '30'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); })()

(() => { const z = document.getElementById('c-zoom'); [1.4, 1.8, 2.2].forEach((val, i) => setTimeout(() => { z.value = val; z.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); if (i === 2) z.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); }, i * 300)); })()

clips.after: curl -s -X PATCH -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"resolution":{"width":1920,"height":1080},"fps":24,"lens":"back-wide","zoom":1}' http://127.0.0.1:47800/api/settings >/dev/null; sleep 4; demo-phone/film-env.sh down
